identity_note: P is current Everpure ticker, formerly PSTG; record data gaps rather than backfill with unverified splice.
biases: Fixed current sector universe, not point-in-time and not evidence of dynamic discovery.
Historical chronological check is exploratory, not genuinely unseen; researcher has prior knowledge of sector and market.
Exclude known Oct5 case and incomplete Oct6 from this experiment.
Signal selection uses only completed bars; missing future execution prices must be reported, not silently substituted.

hypotheses.breakout: Open gap >=1% vs prior regular-session last 5-minute close; from 09:45 to 10:25 bar starts, first completed close above 09:30-09:45 range high; buy at following bar open.
hypotheses.retest: Same gap and opening range; after an earlier qualifying breakout bar, first subsequent 5-minute bar by 10:55 starts with low <= opening high and closes above it; buy at next bar open.

comparators_rule: For each SPY/QQQ buy at09:50 open exit12:00 or15:30; same cost/whole-share constraints. Cash comparator 500 unchanged.
portfolio: Each path starts500 with no replenishment, no leverage, no shorts and integer shares. At most one selected attempt per day, earliest signal first; simultaneous signals rank larger opening gap then alphabetic. If selected stock unaffordable, remain cash that day; do not retrospectively choose runner-up. Sell only at the fixed exit. Sales proceeds are not reused that day (assumed available next session; actual account settlement constraints not validated).
fills: Hypothetical bar-open execution plus adverse10/25bp each side; no proof of NBBO liquidity, queues, spread, price improvement or actual fills. No stop/target intrabar inference.
missing_policy: Use broker calendar, including early closes. Eligibility uses prior close and completed opening bars only. Record whole-session completeness diagnostically, never filter candidates using future bar availability. If a chosen entry/exit print is missing, flag the path incomplete and stop its capital ledger; do not choose an alternative winner.
outputs: All symbol-day candidates, signal and skip reasons
All16 noncash paths:8 sector variants and8 ETF comparators, plus cash; no discarded losers.
Per-path daily ledger and all hypothetical trades
Daily close drawdown only, not intraday drawdown
Both periods, contribution/residual accounting and no10000 guarantee
next_forward: Freeze any promoted candidate in a future-dated paper-research protocol before observing future outcome; do not activate broker trading from this study.
corporate_action_policy: No point-in-time corporate-action file available. Exclude abs raw opening gap >20% from both sector rules, disclose this loses genuine large events too. Raw prices preserve historical whole-share affordability; smaller split/dividend distortions remain a limitation.
entry_latency: After the signal bar completes, wait one full additional five-minute interval and use the following bar open (signal start +10min). Baseline ETFs enter09:50. This avoids assuming zero processing time at the same bar boundary.
